hard_fails_by_judge.fail: AN UNVERIFIED UNIVERSAL PRESENTED AS VERIFIED, REFUTED BY THE RUN'S OWN CLAIMS (web edition, /home/user/TexasAIDocket/ledger/articles/2026-09-30.json, introduction paragraph 2). The sentence reads: 'The machine is the first reader of every written answer a Texas student types on the English language test.' It carries no claim id, which breaks the house rule that every fact carries one. c1 covers constructed responses only, and c22 says the automated model reviews short and extended constructed-response questions. c21 defines text entry responses as answers 'where students type brief text', and c20 says none of the regraded (text entry) responses were graded by the automated scoring engine. So typed answers exist that the engine did not score. The same document says so itself two sections later: 'the correction that moved school ratings this fall came from people reading answers the machine never scored.' Repair: scope the sentence to the longer written answers, the short and extended constructed responses (c22), and tag it. The same unscoped set is on slide-01's dek and the caption's opening line and must be scoped in the same edit (see defects 1 and 2).
